methodology.input_limit: Four logs, each below 40 MiB; actual selected log plus recent and two larger bounded samples.
methodology.owner_estimator: Unique object graph: containers, dataclass fields and instance dict overhead, known disk_sequence/selected_history owner attrs; excludes parser globals, finalizers, and native allocation internals.

limitations: Offline probes do not enumerate objects in the running HUD process.
Import graphs overlap; cold-root measurements cannot be added.
Tracemalloc changes process memory; use the separate untraced replay for process-level results.
Four samples do not establish a bound for all possible snapshots.
Module source labels outside this repository use basenames and can be ambiguous.
